title: Zesty Fermented Syrian Feta Cheese Wrap
description: A quick-fix, low-carb-friendly Syrian dish featuring cubed feta cheese, a tangy deglaze, and a hint of fresh herbs, wrapped in a corn husk.

ingredients.name: chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: add fresh herbs for a pop of color and flavor

ingredients.name: minced garlic
ingredients.notes: mellow out the pungency by roasting the garlic

ingredients.name: chopped fresh mint
ingredients.notes: add a hint of freshness to balance the tanginess

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a light hand, as the feta will be rich

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use a flaky sea salt for added depth

instructions: Roast the garlic by wrapping it in foil and baking at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until soft and mashed.
Chop the parsley and mint, and set aside.
Cube the feta cheese into 1-inch (2.5 cm) pieces, and place in a bowl.
In a small skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat, then add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the lemon juice, crushed red pepper flakes, and salt to the skillet, and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour the deglaze over the feta cheese, and toss to coat.
To assemble the wraps, lay a corn husk flat, then fill with a few pieces of the feta cheese mixture, some chopped parsley and mint, and a sprinkle of salt.
Fold the bottom half of the husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients, and serve immediately.
